\section*{Credited prior work}

The results of this paper build on the following established work. Each
entry names an established result as it is used here and cites its sources.

\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}
\item Characterizations of ideal (Lueders) measurements by nondisturbance of eigenstates~\cite{pwluders1950zustandsanderung,pwbusch1998luders}.
\item Convex decompositions of finite density matrices and common-domain classification for finite transition systems~\cite{pwhughston1993complete,pwbaier2008principles}.
\item Deterministic arithmetic expansion of Born weights for declared effects~\cite{pwborn1926quantenmechanik,pwbusch1995operational}.
\item Finite source-relation transitions aligned with normalized projective-instrument outcomes~\cite{pwluders1950zustandsanderung,pwheinosaari2011mathematical}.
\item Finite-dimensional Robertson uncertainty, projective superselection, random-unitary pinching, and Umegaki entropy~\cite{pwrobertson1929uncertainty,pwwick1952intrinsic,pwbhatia1997matrix,pwumegaki1962conditional}.
\item Lueders instruments and the non-uniqueness of instruments compatible with a given POVM (Davies-Lewis, Ozawa)~\cite{pwluders1950zustandsanderung,pwdavies1970operational,pwozawa1984quantum}.
\item Operational quantum tomography and POVM instrument formalizations~\cite{pwprugovecki1977information,pwdariano2003quantum,pwdavies1970operational,pwbusch2016quantum}.
\item Pauli-Y Born weights read the imaginary off-diagonal state coordinate~\cite{pwnielsen2010quantum}.
\item Qubit state tomography and POVM effect calculus~\cite{pwjames2001measurement,pwparis2004quantum,pwkraus1983states,pwheinosaari2011mathematical}.
\item Standard CHSH saturation by the Bell state and rotated measurements~\cite{tsirelson1980,chsh1969}.
\end{itemize}
